basic_profile.bio: I'm a 34-year-old software engineer based in Northern Cyprus. My interests range from exploring cutting-edge technology to engaging in niche hobbies like wire wrapping and JOI content creation. I work remotely, which allows me to travel frequently and indulge in my passion for electric vehicles and futuristic designs, such as the Cybertruck. In my downtime, I enjoy discussing strategy and lore related to the Black Templars from the Warhammer 40k universe. I'm in a long-term relationship and typically browse Reddit during the late evenings. I have a strong curiosity towards unconventional topics but maintain a balanced and open-minded perspective.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a degree in Computer Science and over a decade of experience in software development, I have a robust understanding of technology and its applications. My self-driven interest in hobbies like wire wrapping and content creation has also led me to explore and contribute to various niche communities. I stay updated on tech trends and enjoy sharing insights with others.
